Name: Earthy Interiors and Cat Valley Counter Patch
Author: susurrusshivers
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]I had an issue when using both DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors and RimeNovi's Cat Valley (Interface) where the countertop at Pierre's turned a whitish-purple color after buying the final backpack upgrade. After some isolation tests, the issue was located with LooseSprites/Cursors in Cat Valley, so hence this fix came about. Not sure if anyone else has this issue, but the visual bug was bothering me so I'm sharing this just in case.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]This is a separate Content Patcher pack. It does not modify Cat Valley's files.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

1. Download Cat Valley and Earthy Interiors and place in Mods folder.
2. Put the folder Earthy Cat Valley Counter Fix in Stardew Valley/Mods.
3. Launch through SMAPI.

Enjoy.
